messages:
Marco: Quick async check — rolling up v2 compatibility lanes. Who's owning: SDK surface, gateway proxy changes, docs migration notes, and canary smoke? Need owners + short blockers by EOD. :eyes:
Priya: I can take SDK surface (JS + Python). Will list breaking changes and migration snippets. ETA tomorrow noon. :+1:
Dave: Gateway proxy/ingress changes — I can own. Need infra to confirm LB rollout windows. Pinging @Sylvia.
Anya: Docs migration notes — happy to own, will ask for diffs from SDK PRs. Quick question: do we already have the new example responses for streaming + function calls?
Marco: we have examples but they need updating for streaming chunked format. Priya can push snippets.
Priya: adding streaming example now. Example curl for smoke: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-2","input":"hi"}'``` Will also show chunked response parse.
Sylvia: infra: LB rollout window is open Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC. I can validate health checks and canary slice. Dave, confirm proxy config ready for that window.
Dave: good for me. I'll upload the proxy patch to the canary branch tonight. Quick note: proxy change requires a config flag flip in staging: `enable_v2_compat=true` — I'll include a rollout playbook.
Anya: for docs, can you paste the playbook? I want to document rollback steps and observable signals.
Dave: playbook snippet: "check canary logs for 5xx spike, validate token propagation by sampling /v2/health responses, if >1% error rollback flag to false" — will post full steps in PR.
Marco: ownership summary for tracking: SDK -> Priya; Gateway -> Dave; Docs -> Anya; Infra window -> Sylvia. I'll add to the migration board and tag owners. Any blockers?
Priya: small blocker: break in our telemetry namespace — tokens are reported under old_metric_v1 in a couple SDKs. Need a tiny SDK patch to emit v2_metric. Will open PR in an hour.
Anya: Can someone add the migration checklist item: "verify eval suite against v2 generation for top-10 prompts" — we should detect regressions early.
Marco: added. Also, @deploy-bot will run a canary smoke after the proxy patch lands. Deploy-bot: please create a scheduled canary run once Dave's PR is merged.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary run on merge to canary branch, will post result summary in this thread. :robot_face:
Sylvia: FYI — security review is green for the proxy changes but want to audit token propagation logs after canary. I'll slot a quick audit task.
Dave: noted. I'll include extra logging to make audit easier.
Priya: will coordinate release notes and migration snippets; tagging eng-docs in PR for visibility.
Marco: thanks all. If no objections, I'll mark owners in the release ticket and set the cutoff for final changes at 48h before the infra window. Ping here if anything slips. :raised_hands:
